liner_blank_note: Geometric minimum only; add material for corner folds, attachment overlap and wrapping the doorway curb.

roof_load_study.load_case: Conservatively put the entire entered hanging load at midspan of one interior crossmember, plus its tributary roof dead load.
roof_load_study.status: NOT LOAD RATED. Confirm light/hardware weights, lumber species/grade, service conditions, roof/ceiling panel spans, bearing, joints, wall bracing and freestanding stability. E and dead load are illustrative; creep is excluded.

environment.caveat: Illustrative inputs, assumed whole-assembly R values. No leakage, solar, thermal-bridge/surface-temperature simulation, transient storage, ventilation heat, or dehumidifier heat. Uninsulated slab heat transfer is excluded; slab temperature and ground coupling are unknown. Moisture-only airflow is not a fan selection or a fresh-air requirement.

sheet_note: Net area only: add seams/blocking, nesting and waste. Large panels need joined sheets.
cut_note: Concept pieces. Tray solids describe folds in one sheet, not separate pieces to cut. Jamb returns, stops, seals, seam blocking, fasteners and hanging hardware not quantified.
